author: CeliaFernandez
body:
#### PR description:

This PR collects the proposed changes in the flavored MUO NanoAOD samples for the v16 version.
The additional information intends to serve to measure both tracking and muon reconstruction efficiencies, that until now were measured with Mini/AOD formats.

These changes are in agreement with the TRK POG, who will also profit from this additions to measure the tracking reconstruction efficiencies using the MUO NanoAOD. This NanoAOD will be used by both groups.

**Summary of changes:**
- Thresholds of the pfCandidates and lostTracks are lowered to 2 GeV. These objects constitute a subset of the original ```generalTracks``` whose efficiency is to be measured. Since MiniAOD muon selection is restricted to 3 GeV, 2 GeV constitutes an appropriate threshold to cope with the different resolution between tracker and muon system tracks. Formally this requirement was set to 15 GeV preventing this NanoAOD to be used to measure any tracking efficiency below that value.
- Added the propagation of the pfCandidate+lostTracks to MB1 that we intend to use to improve the matching between tracks in the tracker and muon system (propEta, propPhi)
- Added the innerPosition of standalone muons to perform the same matching
- Added standalone errors at the PCA
- Added additional track parameters and errors

Precision is also adjusted to minimise the increase in size due to the addition of the extra tracks.

#### PR validation:

Clean build, code checks, also run successfully standard battery of tests.
